FAQPreview.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQPreview.description: Got questions? We've got answers. If you have some other questions, feel free to contact us.

0.q: How long does the recharge take?
0.a: After you submit your payment proof, our team manually verifies it. Most orders are processed within 15-30 minutes during working hours.

1.q: Where can I find my MLBB User ID?
1.a: Open Mobile Legends, tap your profile picture in the top left corner. Your User ID is the number shown below your settings (e.g., 123456789).

2.q: Where can I find my Zone ID?
2.a: The Zone ID is the 4-digit number in parentheses right next to your User ID on your MLBB profile page (e.g., (1234)).

3.q: What happens if my payment is rejected?
3.a: If we cannot verify your payment, your order will be marked as rejected. Our support team will contact you to resolve the issue or process a refund.

4.a: You select your package, enter your game details, and pay using your preferred method. Once you upload the payment proof and we verify it, we send the Diamonds directly to your account.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1_text: At {name}, we collect only the necessary information to process your orders. This includes your Game ID, phone number (for contact purposes regarding your order), and payment proof images.
Privacy.s2_text: We use the collected information exclusively to fulfill your digital top-up orders, verify payments, and communicate with you if there are issues with your transaction.
Privacy.s3_text: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information. We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal identification information to others.
Privacy.s4_text: Payment proofs are retained only as long as necessary to resolve any disputes or verify the completion of the transaction, after which they may be deleted from our systems.
Privacy.s5_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us via our WhatsApp support or at {email}.

Terms.s2_text: We provide a digital platform to facilitate the top-up of gaming credits, specifically Mobile Legends: Bang Bang Diamonds in Algeria. We act as an intermediary for these digital goods.

Terms.s4_text: Due to the digital nature of the goods, refunds are only issued if we are unable to deliver the Diamonds after payment verification. Once Diamonds are delivered, all sales are final.
